t: This is the Royal College of Physicians, a building designed by Sir Denys Lasdun. He was an English architect, hailed as the greatest English architect of the early heroic modern period. His best-known work is the Royal National Theatre on the South Bank, a Grade II* listed building and one of the most notable examples of Brutalist design in the United Kingdom. Here you can see his modern approach applied to a very different kind of institution, so it's worth comparing it with the theatre if you know it.
